title: The Impact Economy: Turning Disclosure into Demand
gist: A WEF/Schwab Foundation report says only 15% of SDG targets with trend data are on track and argues disclosure must be turned into economic demand for outcomes via regulatory, commercial, financial and collaborative pathways, using healthcare as a testbed.

insights.claim: Only 15% of Sustainable Development Goal targets with sufficient trend data are on track even as companies disclose more social impact.
insights.speaker: World Economic Forum
insights.so_what: Disclosure has not translated into outcomes.

insights.claim: The report identifies four pathways to make impact economically actionable: regulatory, commercial, financial and collaborative demand, using healthcare as a testbed and the 'impact paradox' as framing.
insights.speaker: World Economic Forum
insights.so_what: Outcome-based financing models are the direction for impact investing.
